primary_seal_semantics: while holding the exclusive series lock, persist the primary terminal with existing create-only rules and fsync every file and directory
once the primary terminal is durable, the attempt is sealed and its terminal outcome is irreversible

if a process dies before terminalization, the next lock holder replays and classifies the persisted attempt as INCOMPLETE_UNTERMINALIZED, freezes exactly the primary bytes then present, keeps terminal.json absent and completes that frozen-history mirror before allocating a later ordinal
a later mirror failure never deletes, rewrites, rolls back or reclassifies a sealed terminal attempt or frozen incomplete primary bytes
part_7_attempt_seal_and_second_copy_fail.snapshot_scope: After each terminal seal, and before carrying any replay-confirmed INCOMPLETE_UNTERMINALIZED record into a later ordinal, copy the entire live ledger as of that ordinal, including series.json and all attempts through the sealed or frozen ordinal, into a new create-only secondary snapshot.

compute the sorted live-ledger inventory and Merkle root plus relative path, mode, bytes, SHA-256, file count, total bytes and history root

reject symlink, hardlink, special-file, alias and overlapping primary/secondary ancestors; prohibit clonefile/reflink APIs and copy with explicit read/write without claiming APFS extent sharing can be detected afterward

on the first mirror only, create the registered secondary snapshot root and both receipt roots with one-level create-only mkdir mode 0700 under owner-provisioned containers and fsync all three parents; later mirrors require exact owner, mode and non-alias properties
copy bytes into a unique same-parent staging directory with O_EXCL; directories are 0700 and files are 0600
fsync each file, each directory and the staging parent
independently re-read the secondary tree and recompute inventory, history root and live-ledger root
require exact equality of relative paths, modes, bytes, per-file SHA-256, history root and live-ledger root

on exact macOS publish the same-parent staging directory only with renameatx_np and RENAME_EXCL=0x00000004, require success, fsync the final parent and re-read the published tree; absent-check plus os.rename is forbidden

construct one canonical receipt byte string and publish it with O_CREAT|O_EXCL under both receipt roots with the same filename; fsync each receipt and parent, then require independently re-read receipt bytes to be identical
